title: Record a supplier payment
intro: Record a payment already executed outside Stoquify after independent approval. This updates invoice paid balances; it does not send money or verify bank settlement.
independent: The requester and approver cannot record execution. An independent authorized user must do this.
evidenceHelp: Use the issued receipt for this exact payment. Preserve the approved request and attach execution evidence separately.
referenceHelp: Copy the full unique transaction or receipt reference, including its issuing bank/provider. Use a payment-line reference, not a shared batch number.
executedAtHelp: Copy the verified time with timezone, for example 2026-09-08T14:30:00+02:00. It must follow approval and have the approved accounting date.
uriHelp: Use the access-controlled web link where authorized reviewers can open the retained bank confirmation or receipt.
hashHelp: Copy the final file’s 64-character SHA-256, or select the file below. A hash does not verify the signer or bank.
fileHelp: Calculated locally, up to 20 MB. This does not upload the file or create its link.
fileLarge: Choose a file smaller than 20 MB.
hashFailed: The file hash could not be calculated. Try again.
effect: Confirm only a payment already executed. Recording reduces the supplier balance and adds paid amounts to invoice allocations. Posting may need recovery; statement reconciliation remains separate.
pending: A confirmation reference is retained. Retry this exact record to resolve its outcome; do not record the payment again.
passwordFailed: Password verification failed. Check your password and try again.
settlement: This is retained operator evidence. Bank settlement requires statement matching and reconciliation controls.
denied: Your current access does not allow this operation. Sign in again or ask your administrator to review permissions.
evidenceRequired: Retained request, approval or execution evidence needs review. Inspect history before proceeding.
stale: Payment or accounting sources changed. Your draft is retained; review the current terms again.
duplicate: This reference already belongs to a recorded payment or different evidence. Inspect history before recording anything else.
chronology: Execution must follow approval, cannot be in the future and must have the approved accounting date.
periodUnavailable: Exactly one open accounting period must cover the approved date. Ask the accounting owner to review period setup.
invalid: Complete the execution reference, timestamp with timezone, evidence web link and SHA-256.
conditions: Current payment, destination, invoice or accounting conditions prevent recording. Review source records.
unknown: The outcome could not be confirmed. Keep this reference and retry the same recording.
loadFailed: Payment data could not be loaded. Retry; an empty list has not been confirmed.
storage: This browser could not retain the draft or retry reference. Enable session storage before recording.
cleanupFailed: The payment recording is confirmed, but this browser could not clear its saved retry reference. Keep the confirmed result; reloading may show the same reference again.

warningsCopy.POSTING_RULE_UNAVAILABLE: No usable payment posting rule was found. Recording may leave a blocked posting to recover.
warningsCopy.JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE: No active payment journal is available.
warningsCopy.COUNTRY_TREATMENT_REVIEW: Country or withholding treatment requires accounting review.
